name: gempt-magpie-routing-template
description: Portable 3-tier Magpie routing template (group/gempt-harness-sonnet, group/gempt-harness-opus, group/gempt-harness-fable) + free/fast utility lane for compaction & grunt work.
antigravity_note: Gemini acts as the human-facing lead (native official channel in Antigravity, or Magpie's antigravity/gemini-4-* quota in external MCP clients), while all GPT/Codex calls route through local Magpie. Optional group/gempt-harness-* groups hold only GPT/Codex + utility compact rules and coexist without conflict alongside root install.sh's group/gempt-* presets.

gempt-harness-sonnet.use_cases: 约 75% 日常写代码、UI/前端、单测与常规修改
gempt-harness-sonnet.compact_rule: magpie group rule add gempt-harness-sonnet use=<utility_model> compact

gempt-harness-opus.use_cases: 约 20% 跨文件重构、复杂排查与架构设计（Sol @ high + 疑难 @ xhigh 升 Astra）
gempt-harness-opus.escalation_rule: magpie group rule add gempt-harness-opus use=codex/gpt-6.2-astra effort=xhigh
gempt-harness-opus.compact_rule: magpie group rule add gempt-harness-opus use=<utility_model> compact

gempt-harness-fable.use_cases: 约 5% 极难 Bug、核心算法/数学推导、长程架构攻坚
gempt-harness-fable.compact_rule: magpie group rule add gempt-harness-fable use=<utility_model> compact

optional_multi_account_note: If you have multiple Codex/ChatGPT accounts in Magpie, pin accounts with `#<account>` (e.g. codex/gpt-6.2-astra#primary,codex/gpt-6.2-astra#backup) or configure `routing=drain` / `routing=smart` directly in Magpie.
